# yap-forever

> Claude Code plugin for WoW: Forever players: the cheapest profession levelling routes and
> shopping lists from the player's own auction house prices. Python 3.11+ standard library.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it does, install, privacy, command line
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for agents working on this repository
- [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md): state of the project for people picking it up
- [docs/project-setup.md](docs/project-setup.md): working agreements (branches, CI, tags, reviews)
- [docs/progress.md](docs/progress.md): finished tasks, one line each
- [docs/skill-checks.md](docs/skill-checks.md): skill cases run by hand before a tag
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute; [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): reporting leaks

## The skill

Players install only `plugin/` (the marketplace's source): the skill, the planner package, the
licence and the credits. Tests and project documents stay at the repository root.


- [plugin/skills/forever-professions/SKILL.md](plugin/skills/forever-professions/SKILL.md): workflow for Claude
- [references/setup.md](plugin/skills/forever-professions/references/setup.md): first-time setup
- [references/list-layout.md](plugin/skills/forever-professions/references/list-layout.md): how routes are written
- [references/game-rules.md](plugin/skills/forever-professions/references/game-rules.md): Forever rules learned in play
- [references/coverage.md](plugin/skills/forever-professions/references/coverage.md): what the planner covers and what not yet

## Code

- `plugin/yap_forever/cli.py`: commands `init`, `check`, `probe`, `prices`, `plan`, `migrate`
- `plugin/yap_forever/settings.py`: the player's home folder and paths; credentials loader
- `plugin/yap_forever/profile.py`: profile (region, ruleset, faction, characters), auction house file
- `plugin/yap_forever/planner.py`, `costmodel.py`: route search and costs
- `plugin/yap_forever/gamedata.py`: pinned game data sources (see [plugin/CREDITS.md](plugin/CREDITS.md))
- `plugin/yap_forever/report.py`, `guide.py`: report and guide rendering
- `plugin/yap_forever/plan.py`, `compare.py`, `trips.py`, `shopping.py`: both routes, the comparison, trips away, shopping list and mailbox trips
- `tests/`: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`
